scripts.build:css: npx --yes clean-css-cli -o css/production.min.css css/bootstrap.min.css css/font-awesome.min.css css/style.css
scripts.build:js: npx uglifyjs js/jquery.min.js js/bootstrap.min.js js/SmoothScroll.min.js js/index.js js/top.js js/bgfader.js js/timeline.js js/home.js js/colorfulTab.min.js js/jqBootstrapValidation.js -o js/production.min.js
scripts.build:images: npx imagemin images/* --out-dir=dist/images --plugin=jpegtran --plugin=pngquant && npx imagemin assets/* --out-dir=dist/assets --plugin=jpegtran --plugin=pngquant
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:images
